description:
Read the documentation

Returns the API guide as Markdown: what each operation is for, how to turn a user's request into
category ids and a location, request and response shapes, how to read scores. Call this once per session.
name: get_docs

outputSchema.description: The guide itself is the tool result's text content (Markdown); structuredContent carries the call_id and, except for ChatGPT, the same guide as `guide`.

guide.description: The full guide, as Markdown: the same as the text content. Absent for ChatGPT, which shows the model the text content too.

title: Read the Atly API guide
